name: scrip
description: Stocks you own, from money already moving on Solana. A slice of every USDC payment becomes tokenized stock in your wallet by itself; whoever pays you can match it; and tokens launched on Scrip Curve (Meteora DBC, priced in the Nasdaq 100, S&P 500, Tesla or Nvidia) pay a share of their trading fees into those matches. Live on mainnet.

paragraphs: Stocks you own, from money already moving on Solana.

A slice of every USDC payment you receive becomes tokenized stock in your own wallet, by itself. Whoever pays you can match it, with a Plan the program enforces. And every token launched on Scrip Curve, a Meteora launch priced in a stock, pays a share of its trading fees into those matches. Three ways stock reaches a saver, one program, every step on a receipt anyone can open.
